INVOICE_OVERDUE.title: Overdue invoice
INVOICE_OVERDUE.when: {state, select, past {Overdue by {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} today {Due today} other {Due in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

INVOICE_DUE_SOON.title: Invoice due soon
INVOICE_DUE_SOON.when: {state, select, past {Overdue by {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} today {Due today} other {Due in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

INSTALLMENT_TO_INVOICE.title: Installment to invoice
INSTALLMENT_TO_INVOICE.when: {state, select, past {Should have been invoiced {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago} today {To invoice today} other {To invoice in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

DOCUMENT_EXPIRING.title: Document expiring
DOCUMENT_EXPIRING.when: {state, select, past {Expired {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago} today {Expires today} other {Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

DOCUMENT_EXPIRED.title: Expired document
DOCUMENT_EXPIRED.when: {state, select, past {Expired {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago} today {Expires today} other {Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

RECURRING_EXPENSE_PENDING.title: Pending recurring expense
RECURRING_EXPENSE_PENDING.when: {state, select, past {Overdue by {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} today {Due today} other {Due in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

PAYMENT_PENDING_VERIFICATION.title: Payment to verify
PAYMENT_PENDING_VERIFICATION.when: {state, select, past {Recorded {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago} today {Recorded today} other {Recorded in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

UNALLOCATED_CREDIT.title: Unallocated credit
UNALLOCATED_CREDIT.when: {state, select, past {Unallocated for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} today {Unallocated since today} other {Unallocated in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}

MISSING_RATE.title: Missing VES rate
MISSING_RATE.when: {state, select, past {No rate} today {No rate for today} other {No rate}}

toasts.snoozed: Alert snoozed for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
